map.算法（MDRD 175 简化式）：eGFR = 175 × SCr^(-1.15: Algorithm (MDRD 175 simplified): eGFR = 175 × SCr^(-1.154) × age^(-0.203) × (female ×0.742), in mL/min/1.73m². Serum creatinine may be entered in mg/dL or µmol/L (auto-converted; 1 mg/dL ≈ 88.4 µmol/L). SCr >0 and age 18-120 years required.
map.例1（SCr 1.0 mg/dL、50 岁、男）：eGFR = 175×1.0^: Example 1 (SCr 1.0 mg/dL, age 50, male): eGFR = 175×1.0^(-1.154)×50^(-0.203) = 79.1 mL/min/1.73m², stage G2. Example 2 (SCr 1.5 mg/dL, age 65, female): eGFR = 175×1.5^(-1.154)×65^(-0.203)×0.742 = 34.9 mL/min/1.73m², stage G3b (below 60, refer to nephrology).
map.和 egfr 那版有何不同？: How is it different from the egfr version?
map.本版用 MDRD 175 简化式，血肌酐可选 mg/dL 或 µmol/L；eg: This version uses the MDRD 175 simplified equation with serum creatinine in mg/dL or µmol/L; the egfr version uses full CKD-EPI 2009. The formulas differ, so numbers are not directly comparable; enter values using the unit selected on the page.
map.eGFR 低就一定是肾病吗？: Does a low eGFR always mean kidney disease?
map.不一定，脱水、感染、药物可一过性降低；慢性肾病定义为 eGFR<60 持续 ≥3: Not necessarily; dehydration, infection and drugs can lower it transiently. Chronic kidney disease is defined as eGFR <60 for ≥3 months, requiring re-testing and judgement together with urine protein.
